name: Data.isLiftWeight_kappa
summary: The three conditions by arithmetic on the column heights of κ.

steps.claim: The ranks are increasing; a column of height between |X_j| and |X_{j+1}| would give a divisibility of h − k by t + 1 strictly between consecutive multiples (`Nat.not_dvd_of_lt_of_lt_mul_succ`); the last entry by cases on j and the definitions of |X_j|, n, κ, lastEntry.
steps.lean:
(D.X (j + 1)) / 2 : ℕ) - D.w (j + 1) ·) (D.lastEntry j) := ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨by grind, fun h ↦ by
    have := @Nat.not_dvd_of_lt_of_lt_mul_succ (D.t + 1) j (h - D.k)
    grind [κ]⟩, by grind, by cases j <;> simp [funext_iff, ↓card_X, n, κ, lastEntry] <;> grind⟩
